scope: Unweighted 5D Bayesian phi_h. Copy of fits/unweighted/dimension/5D/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian and BC_RC_Bayesian are absent and were not created. The unweighted nominal acceptance fit was not copied onto these histograms. No publication. The source file and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: the spline keys these 5D histograms select have median B width 0.2225 on the 192 bins that set B limits, only 4 of 452 narrower than 0.05, and 260 with no B limits. C windows are wider. Those windows are not tight enough to pin the campaign, so the run-local guide imports Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not passed. The nominal acceptance refinement was a comparison source only.
changed: Pass 1 fit all 452 with that guide. It improved 16 histograms and made 13 worse because a tight limit or the second fit pass left the cosine those points support. The worst was (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16), chi2 25.43 to 281.50, with B driven from -0.182 to -0.037. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) went from chi2 17.609 to 18.409 and pinned C at 0. Pass 2 put the missed bins on each histogram's own wide-limit cosine and opened only those limits, then refit Q2-y 1-9 and 11-17. Q2-y 10 was not refit and stayed at the pass-1 result. Pass 3 removed the spline 15-345 cut on (Q2_y_Bin_12)-(z_pT_Bin_13), which had dropped a nonempty bin at 0-15 degrees, and refit Q2-y 12. The filled window 0-345 is restored, NDF 20. JSON still has 452. No retained bin is worse than the stored fit on the same filled window. Improved bins include (Q2_y_Bin_11)-(z_pT_Bin_3) chi2 38.96 to 25.45 (NDF 19), B -0.0751 to -0.1258, C -0.0002 to -0.0085; (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_21) chi2 37.37 to 24.20 (NDF 17), B -0.0469 to -0.0951, C 0.0110 to -0.0112; (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_7) chi2 46.25 to 35.75 (NDF 21), B -0.4774 to -0.4847, C 0.0600 to 0.0854; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_24) chi2 52.30 to 42.21 (NDF 19), B -0.2947 to -0.3259, C 0.0433 to 0.0855; (Q2_y_Bin_16)-(z_pT_Bin_12) chi2 39.40 to 29.86 (NDF 21), B -0.3710 to -0.3725, C 0.0600 to 0.0987; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_2) chi2 21.54 to 12.31 (NDF 16), B -0.1012 to -0.1502, C 0.0188 to 0.0119; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_4) chi2 53.40 to 45.75 (NDF 15), B -0.2568 to -0.2193, C -0.0100 to 0.0258; (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) chi2 48.64 to 41.05 (NDF 18), B -0.1996 to -0.2233, C 0.0195 to 0.0552. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) stays at B=-0.028554, statistical error 0.020787, C=0.015730, statistical error 0.011023, chi2 17.609, NDF 13, phi 60-300, 16 bins inside the TF1 range.
left_bins: Bins whose cosine already matched the histogram were left, including all of Q2-y 10. Nominal 3D B and C were not imposed. why_retained: The retained fits follow each 5D histogram. Pass 1 regressions were returned to that cosine, and the bins that were off it now have a lower chi-squared without dropping a nonempty phi bin. No histogram is worse than the stored fit. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) was not replaced by the nominal acceptance result. Fit-parameter errors are not added to a systematic uncertainty.
